content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers (Declarations of Interest)
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during period of guideline development up to and including 2023).
